description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Owner and resolved metadata for one ERC-721/1155 token_id. Requires contract and token_id; optional chain= (default ethereum). Returns JSON owner and resolved metadata for that token id.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Single chain. Format: a chain slug such as ethereum or base. Example: ethereum. Default: ethereum, as the existing tool text states.

contract.description: ERC-721 or ERC-1155 contract. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0xBC4CA0EdA7647A8aB7C2061c2E118A18a936f13D. Required.

token_id.description: Token id inside that contract. Format: a decimal integer as a string. Example: 0. Required.

name: lookup_nft
title: NFT owner + metadata ($0.005)
